`final class SdlMouseButtons`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.base.lwjgl3.sdl.input` · **Module:** `base-lwjgl3-sdl` · **Source:** [SdlMouseButtons.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/base/lwjgl3-sdl/src/main/java/dev/joid/base/lwjgl3/sdl/input/SdlMouseButtons.java)

Maps the mouse buttons of SDL 3, which count from 1, to the mouse buttons of JOID.

## Method details

<a id="SdlMouseButtons-method-getButton"></a>

### getButton

`MouseButton getButton(int button)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Returns the button of the SDL button index: `SDL_BUTTON_LEFT` gives `MouseButton.LEFT`, `SDL_BUTTON_X1` and `SDL_BUTTON_X2` give `BACK` and `FORWARD`, any other index `OTHER`.
